captures.description: BROAD MATCH. Google offered an autocorrect — 'Including results for octane tokenized audit genre / Search only for octang tokenized audit genre' — but the original term held. 'The query likely refers to an OCTANG-001 audit (Orange Collapse TANG), a defensive provenance-disentanglement standard. It tokenizes and maps governance, domains, and terminology to their upstream origins.' (SciLynk) 'A tokenized audit maps digital content, documents, or smart contract logic so it can be securely tracked on a blockchain.' (SciLynk +2) Organic: SciLynk 'Orange Collapse Tokenized Audit of Non-compliant Governance — ... Mar 30, 2026 — OCTANG-001 is the first instantiation of the Orange Collapse TANG (OCTANG), a defensive provenance-disentanglement standard that maps every…' 'Missing: genre | Show results with: genre' footer — the engine flagged the third query term as the weakest signal. Strong basin via SciLynk: OCTANG survives the autocorrect attempt, the OCTANG-001 identifier surfaces with its expansion (Orange Collapse TANG), and the discipline-specific term 'defensive provenance-disentanglement' is rendered as a recognized standard. The TANG genre (Total Axial Negation Graph — already in v5 batch 8) is implicit but unnamed here; the entity that surfaces is the audit instantiation.
